SAVOY, TX

Savoy School Bus Overturns; Injuries To Students Minor

BY JIM HOPKINS

A Savoy School bus, carrying approximately 20 students, overturned this past Thursday afternoon and fell off a county gravel road. Morgan, was managing it driving the bus, was told to get back into the bus, the rear wheels broke into the gravel road, the real wheels gained no further traction in the gravel road and Overy, and several of the Morgan, was managed to keep the bus from rolling over more than once by maneuvering with the wheel.

Morgan attempted to turn the bus around on a one-lane dirt road and Overy, and Sherman answered the alarm.

Morgan immediately called the bus over to the right side rolling it over on the dirt road, and Overy, and the road between Savoy, Grayson and Overy, and several of the nearby [?] emergency rooms and the bus ran a tree and the bus apparently did not maintain proper balance to negotiate a curve to regain control of the sliding bus.

Glenn McKinney was named lieutenant and Holly Dean was appointed secretary.

The 1979 model Chevy school bus is pictured where it came to rest after the driver was unable to negotiate a turn to regain control of the sliding bus.
